name: What is the typical cost of a custom kitchen remodel in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of a custom kitchen remodel in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom kitchen remodel in Las Vegas varies significantly based on factors like size, materials, appliances, and the extent of structural changes. A basic remodel might start around $20,000, while a high-end custom project with premium finishes and major layout alterations could exceed $100,000. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an initial consultation and design phase, ensuring all aspects of your vision are accounted for within your budget.
